correctness.rationale: Automorphisms exhaust exactly three two-leader pair types H (hub+outer), D (outer vertices in different triangles), S (same triangle). For modules A_ij=[[1+r+ik,-r],[-r,1+r+jk]], exact 2x2 inverses and hub Schur complement give J_H,J_D,J_S=tr[(L+k diag 1_S)^(-1)], positive for every m>=2, k,r>0. Algebra yields J_D-J_H=P_m/[2(1+2r)(k(1+r)+2r+1)(k(1+r)+4r+2)] and J_S-J_D=r Q_m/[2(1+2r)(k+2r+1)(k(1+r)+2r+1)] with Q_m positive coefficients. P_m=P4+2(m-4)(1+r)(k(1+r)+2r+1)^2 and P4 has strictly positive coefficients, so H optimal m>=4. At m2,3 Descartes one sign change plus opposite endpoint signs implies a unique positive r-threshold. For m2 r=1/4, P2=(25k²-252k+36)/64 shows H-D-H reentrance at k=(126±24sqrt26)/25. Independent exact rational inversion of full pinned Laplacians for m2/3/4/5 and various r,k matched Schur values and D-H differences incl signs, not a substitute for all-parameter polynomial proof.
